name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity for interactive elements.

This keeps the focus indicator visible on all backgrounds while staying lightweight—glow adds clarity without heavy motion. Trade-off: the glow subtly increases visual noise, but it’s worth it for users who rely on clear focus cues.

name: Reader
text: Glow at 20% opacity risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on light backgrounds—#005FCC at 20% drops contrast too low. Drop the glow, use a 2px solid #005FCC ring at 30% opacity instead; it stays visible without motion and meets contrast on all backgrounds. Test with Playwright MCP on light and dark themes to confirm.
